description: CIRAD published ECOFI ecophysiological field-trial tables for sugarcane and energy cane growth modelling. Its public Dataverse record describes experiments over about twenty years in Réunion, Morocco, Mauritius and Senegal; the metadata gives 1992–2014 as temporal coverage. Plain-text tables include sites, trials, varieties, crop observations, soil properties, weather and irrigation. The named CIRAD Dataverse page opened publicly, shows version two and lists CC BY 4.0. A food-supply modeller could use the observations to set crop-model inputs, check growth simulations or compare site and management responses. Measurements from different trials and countries need their table keys and protocols reconciled before pooling. The page does not establish that every year or location has every variable. The files themselves were not downloaded or inspected, and no price was shown on the public page. The repository also links a related MOSICAS model repository; its identity and eligibility require their own review. No catalogue identity match appeared for ECOFI in the full local duplicate scan.
